# ConnectorAuthenticationSecretInput

A run input that chooses the secret a tool sends with its calls: a run gives the id of a secret, such as one per customer, and the tool sends its value in an HTTP header.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests and responses. In a request it is called `ConnectorAuthenticationSecretInputInput`.

## In a request

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `externalOperationId` | `uuid` |  | The id of the tool whose calls send the secret. |
| `agentId` | `uuid \| null` |  | Only the participant filled by this agent sends the secret. Null: every participant does. |
| `defaultSecretId` | `uuid \| null` |  | The id of the secret sent when a run does not choose one. Null: none. |
| `headerName` | `string` |  | The HTTP header the secret's value is sent in, such as `Authorization`. |
| `name` | `string` | yes | The input's name: a run gives the input's value under this name. Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `description` | `string \| null` |  | What the input is for, shown to whoever starts a run. Constraints: minLength: 1. |
| `isRequired` | `boolean` |  | Whether a run must give the input. A run started without a required input is refused. |

```json
{
  "externalOperationId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "agentId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "defaultSecretId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "headerName": "...",
  "name": "...",
  "description": "...",
  "isRequired": false
}
```
